items.description: Provided photography and video coverage for a Somali humanitarian organisation working across child protection, food security, education, nutrition, health, WASH, peacebuilding and disaster risk reduction.
items.description_so: Waxaan sawirro iyo muuqaallo u duubay urur samafal Soomaaliyeed oo ka shaqeeya ilaalinta carruurta, sugnaanta cuntada, waxbarashada, nafaqada, caafimaadka, biyaha iyo nadaafadda, nabadaynta iyo yareynta khataraha masiibooyinka.

items.description: Registered vulnerable and out-of-school children for education support in Merca and nearby Lower Shabelle communities, including Shalambood and Ceel Jaale.
items.description_so: Waxaan carruurta nugul iyo kuwa dugsiyada ka maqan u diiwaangeliyey taageero waxbarasho gudaha Marka iyo deegaannada ku dhow ee Shabeellaha Hoose, oo ay ku jiraan Shalambood iyo Ceel Jaale.

items.description: Supported sales and produced customised printed products, including T-shirts, mugs and hats.
items.description_so: Waxaan ka shaqeeyey iibka iyo daabacaadda alaabo la habeeyey, sida funaanadaha, koobabka iyo koofiyadaha.

items.description: Produced invitation cards, signboards and roll-up banners, and supported camera shooting for customer and event work.
items.description_so: Waxaan daabacay kaararka casuumaadda, boorarka iyo roll-up banners, sidoo kalena ka shaqeeyey sawir-qaadista macaamiisha iyo munaasabadaha.

items.description: Camera work for the district football association.
items.description_so: Sawir-qaadis iyo duubis loogu talagalay xiriirka kubbadda cagta degmada.
